# thousandeyes_endpoint_agent (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing ThousandEyes Endpoint Agent by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thousandeyes_endpoint_agent" "laptop" {
  agent_name = "Alice's laptop"
}

output "endpoint_agent_id" {
  value = data.thousandeyes_endpoint_agent.laptop.agent_id
}

output "endpoint_agent_name" {
  value = data.thousandeyes_endpoint_agent.laptop.agent_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_name` (String) The exact name of the Endpoint Agent to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) The unique ID of the Endpoint Agent.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
